Narrative: cdk-4 encodes a cyclin-dependent kinase required for positive regulation of the cell cycle; AMso must undergo an asymmetric division during male maturation to produce MCM interneurons. A missense variant could impair CDK-4 activity or regulation and block AMso cell-cycle entry or progression, preventing the division that generates MCMs. The variant is EMS-labeled and moderate impact, increasing plausibility as the causal lesion. [Effect=missense_variant; EMS] [Gene_info: Enabling protein serine/threonine kinase activity; positive regulation of cell cycle].
rationale: Cell-cycle kinase; missense could block AMso asymmetric division and prevent MCM neuron production.

rationale: ceh-36 is a homeodomain transcription factor involved in neuronal fate specification; an upstream variant could alter expression in amphid-associated cells.
